verification.method: scripts/verify/nigeria.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density, land area; largest in Africa and share of Africa (build check)
Births, deaths, natural increase, births per day; only India and China have more births
Fertility 1978 peak/2026/2050; passes Indonesia (2040) and the United States (2057); 2100 total and rank
Life expectancy 1950/2000/2026, lowest of any country or area; infant mortality highest among countries over 100 million (build check)
Median age 2026/2050; urban 1950/2026/2050 and majority year; title, meta description, Article headline, FAQ answers in JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 72 of 72 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
